text:
Rina (CS): Quick synthesis from today's onboarding sprint: three repeat signals from mid-market pilots that look like renewal risks if we don't act: 1) unclear mapping of routes -> invoice line items; 2) intermittent embedding latency spikes impacting in-app search; 3) lack of easy export of route-level usage for procurement. Tagging @Omar (PM) and @Diego (SRE).

Priya (Onboarding): Confirmed. Two pilots asked for a csv export that ties route names to cost columns. One procurement team paused evaluation until they see that.

Nate (AM): On the renewal call this morning the buyer asked for a sample export and a one-page explanation of how per-route charges are computed. They said: "We can't sign unless we can show finance a per-feature cost breakdown."

signal-bot: Captured signal: "need route-level cost export" (signal_id=9902).

Rina (CS): Copied customer quote for context:
```
"We need a CSV that shows route -> tokens -> cost, otherwise we cannot reconcile with our billing model."
```

Diego (SRE): For embedding latency: do we have traces for those tenants? If it's caching/batching misconfig, we can tune quickly. If it's model choice, we need product guidance.

Omar (PM): Proposed plan: short-term playbooks + long-term product work.
- Short-term (this sprint): create sample CSV export template and a one-pager explaining per-route billing, plus run targeted latency profiling on the two at-risk tenants.
- Medium-term (Q2): console feature to show per-route usage, cost forecast, and embedding latency SLO charts.

Omar (PM): Owners: @Nate own customer comms & sample export; @Priya produce AM enablement one-pager; @Diego run profiling and share findings (2-4h). I'll draft the roadmap note and add to triage.

Nate (AM): I'll request the invoice example from the buyer and produce a CSV mapping by EOD.

Priya (Onboarding): I'll create a short checklist for AMs (what to ask, where to get export).

Diego (SRE): I'll run perf traces now. If it's KV cache TTL or batching artifacts, I can propose a config change we can roll immediately. Will post results in this thread.

Rina (CS): Added to CS signal board and set per-route visibility to P0 for these accounts: https://redwood.internal/cs-signals/3598765432

Omar (PM): Note: let's also track customer impact (revenue at risk) in the ticket. Nate, can you add the renewal date & ARR to the triage card?

Nate (AM): Yes. Adding ARR and renewal date now.

signal-bot: New note linked: https://redwood.internal/signals/9902 (tags: billing, embeddings, renewal-risk).

Rina (CS): Thanks team 389 Please update this thread with links to artifacts (CSV draft, perf traces) so we can push a quick mitigation for the buyers.
